verdict.rationale: MX documents a dedicated test platform with four test institutions to connect against, free developer API keys, and testing guidance for the Connect Widget, so developers can exercise integrations without real end-user accounts. Webhooks can also be tested from the Client Dashboard. Missing for 10: an explicit description of the sandbox environment and how it is isolated from production (base URLs, data separation), detail on what the test institutions simulate, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
